settings.heading: Questions & answers
settings.text: Everything about orders, delivery, returns and our products — in one place. Type a word to find your answer faster.

settings.question: How do I place an order?
settings.answer: Add products to the cart and go to checkout. You can order as a guest or log in to see your order history later.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Payment is processed securely at checkout — we never see your card details.

settings.question: How do I use a discount code?
settings.answer: Open the cart and enter the code under “Have a promo code?”. The discount shows right away, before checkout.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Yes, until it ships — usually within a few hours of ordering. Write to us with your order number as soon as possible.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1–2 business days and usually arrive in 2–4 days. You get a tracking link by email once the parcel leaves our warehouse.

settings.question: How much does delivery cost?
settings.answer: Delivery is free on orders over $50. Below that, the price depends on the method you choose at checkout.

settings.question: Do you deliver abroad?
settings.answer: We ship to the EU and the US. Delivery times and prices for your country show at checkout once you enter the address.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Yes — unopened products can be returned within 14 days of delivery, free of charge. Write to us and we will arrange the pickup.

settings.question: When do I get my money back?
settings.answer: Within 3–5 business days after the parcel reaches us, to the card or account you paid with.

settings.question: What if a product arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Send us a photo within 48 hours of delivery and we will send a replacement or refund it — you do not need to return the damaged item.

settings.question: Are your products natural?
settings.answer: We choose formulas without parabens and sulfates, and every product page lists the full ingredients.

settings.question: Are the products safe for children and pets?
settings.answer: Our eco cleaning products are made to be safe around children and pets, and the kids range is marked separately. If in doubt, ask us before you order.

settings.question: How should I store supplements?
settings.answer: In a dry place away from sunlight, below 25 °C, closed tightly after each use. The best-before date is on every pack.

settings.question: Can you help me choose a product?
settings.answer: Of course. Tell us your goal or skin type and we will suggest a few products that fit — every message is answered by a person.

settings.question: Do I need an account to order?
settings.answer: No. An account just saves your addresses and shows your order history.

settings.question: How do gift cards work?
settings.answer: Gift cards are sent by email with a code. Enter the code at checkout; any balance left stays on the card for the next order.

settings.question: How do I unsubscribe from emails?
settings.answer: Use the “Unsubscribe” link at the bottom of any of our emails — it takes effect right away.

settings.heading: Write to us — a person will answer
settings.text: Every message is read by our team, and we reply within a day. Include your order number if the question is about an order.
